The brief instructs Sarah to confirm the address without supplying a complete address. Its scheduling twist also assumes the learner will first suggest one of the two listed slots, making 'offer the other one' unclear for other suggestions.
Make the booking objective require agreeing on a day and time, rather than only suggesting one, so successful completion clearly represents a booked viewing.
